summary_1line: The narrative introduces the prosperous kingdom of Koshala and its capital Ayodhya, ruled by King Dasaratha of the ancient Ikshvaku line.

image_candidates.scene_text: The grand city of Ayodhya stretches with flower-strewn roads and towering gates while King Dasaratha rules in splendor from his palace.
On the banks of the Sarayu River, the magnificent city of Ayodhya rises with banners, gardens, and bustling markets.
